FAQ
Questions about building better landing pages
What features should I look for in a landing page builder?
Look for an intuitive drag-and-drop editor, customizable templates, responsive design, and mobile-optimized publishing. Strong platforms should also support widgets, popups, pop-ups, CTA buttons, a countdown timer, and flexible contact forms without forcing marketers to rely on a developer for every change.
How much does it cost to build a landing page?
Costs depend on whether you hire a designer, developer, or agency, or use an AI landing page generator. A dedicated landing page maker can reduce ongoing web design costs because page creation, hosting, editing, and optimization are handled in one platform. More advanced users may still want access to CSS for additional customization. Leadpages plans start at $99/month for Grow, $199/month for Optimize, and $399/month for Scale, each with a 7-day free trial and 20% off annual billing.
How do I choose the right landing page builder for my business?
Start with what you want the page to accomplish. If you are promoting a lead magnet, collecting enquiries, or running marketing campaigns, prioritize forms, testing, analytics, integrations, and dedicated lead capture pages. If you also manage a large content site, a CMS or WordPress workflow may matter.
Which is the best landing page builder?
The best platform depends on your workflow. Businesses often compare Leadpages, Unbounce, Instapage, Landingi, and ClickFunnels when evaluating campaign-focused platforms. Broader options such as Wix, Squarespace, and Webflow may make more sense when full-site functionality is the priority.
Can I build a landing page for free?
You can build and preview pages before paying, and every plan includes a 7-day free trial with full platform access. Publishing to a live URL, with a custom domain and free SSL, happens on a paid plan. Free landing-page tools exist, but they usually add their own branding, cap your traffic, and leave out A/B testing and integrations.
How can I create an effective landing page without coding skills?
Start with an AI-generated draft or template, then use a drag-and-drop builder to customize it visually. You should be able to move drag and drop elements, update copy and imagery, adjust forms, and strengthen the main call-to-action without touching code. An AI assistant can also help refine sections, offers, and messaging.
What's the difference between normal landing page builders and AI ones?
Modern landing page platforms use artificial intelligence and other AI-powered tools to speed up creation and optimization. The best tools go beyond generating a page. They help marketers refine copy, structure, imagery, forms, offers, and the primary CTA before the campaign goes live.
What happens to my existing pages?
Nothing changes unless you want it to. Your pages keep working. Choose an old or new experience any time. Your price stays the same.
How can I improve my landing page conversion rate?
Effective conversion optimization starts with a clear offer and an obvious next step. Simplify forms, remove unnecessary distractions, improve messaging, and add relevant testimonials or other social proof where they help reduce uncertainty. Use heatmaps to understand visitor behaviour and identify areas worth testing.
Can I connect landing pages to analytics and advertising platforms?
Yes. Connect landing pages with Google Analytics, Google Ads, and Meta Pixel so you can understand where visitors come from and which campaigns generate results. These integrations can connect ad activity with on-page behaviour and downstream conversions.
What marketing tools should a landing page builder integrate with?
Look for integrations with the systems where your leads and customers already live. Common examples include Mailchimp, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, and Shopify, along with platforms such as GetResponse, Brevo, Omnisend, AWeber, and MailerLite.
What can I add to a landing page to increase engagement?
Depending on the campaign, useful elements can include quizzes, chatbots, lead capture forms, video, FAQs, and subtle animations. If you sell online, you may also connect pages to an online store, create focused product pages, or send visitors into a dedicated checkout experience.
What should I look for in a free landing page builder, is Leadpages free?
Check whether the platform lets you publish a real page, capture leads, connect your marketing stack, measure performance, and remove platform branding. Also consider whether you can create supporting creative tools such as Canva and connect it to the rest of your campaign workflow. Ultimately, we do offer 7 days free platform access.

FAQ
Questions we hear before every signup
What's included in the free trial?
Full access to whichever plan you choose for 7 days. On Grow, you can run A/B tests and use dynamic text replacement. On Optimize, you also get Smart Traffic, heatmaps, and auto-personalization. No feature restrictions during your trial.
What happens when my trial ends?
On day 7 it becomes your paid plan unless you cancel. Your pages stay saved.
What's the difference between publishing features and optimization features?
Publishing features come with every plan: build and ship landing pages, websites, and blogs with custom domains, SSL, and the AI editor. Optimization features start on Grow and add the CRO layer: A/B testing, dynamic text replacement, personalization, anonymous traffic detection, and lead enrichment — then Smart Traffic, heatmaps, and auto-personalization on Optimize. Start with Pro or Business if you just need to publish; move up to Grow when conversion optimization becomes part of your workflow. Your pages and domains carry over either way.
Is there a traffic cap?
No. Unlimited traffic on every plan. No traffic overage fees. No penalties when your campaigns succeed. This is a fundamental difference from Unbounce (20K cap at $99) and Instapage (15K cap at $99).
Do all plans include A/B testing?
No. Manual A/B testing starts on Grow. Smart Traffic and heatmaps start on Optimize. Pro and Business are publishing plans and do not include these testing features.
Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. Cancel anytime from your account settings.
Do I need a credit card to start?
Yes. A card starts your 7-day trial, and checkout shows its price before you pay. If it's $1, it counts toward your first month. Cancel anytime.
How do AI credits work?
Every plan includes a monthly AI credit allotment (40K on Grow, 80K on Optimize, 160K on Scale). Credits power AI page creation, URL imports, and AI chat. Credits refill at the start of each billing cycle. If you need more, top-up packs are available from $2.50.
How does annual billing work?
Pay annually and save 20%. You're billed once per year.
What happens to my existing Leadpages pages?
Nothing changes unless you want it to. Your pages keep working. You choose old or new experience any time. Your current price stays the same.
Can I change plans later?
Yes. Upgrade or downgrade anytime. Changes take effect on your next billing cycle. No penalties.
What integrations are supported?
HubSpot, Salesforce, Mailchimp, Google Ads, Stripe, Shopify, Slack, Zapier, and 200+ more through Paragon. Leads flow directly to your CRM or email tool via webhooks.
Do you offer discounts for nonprofits or education?
Contact [email protected] . We evaluate nonprofit and education pricing on a case-by-case basis.
How is this different from the Leadpages I know?
We rebuilt the product from the ground up. Same team, same 13-year track record. New technology. A/B testing and dynamic text replacement start at $99/mo. Smart Traffic, heatmaps, and auto-personalization start at $199/mo. AI page creation and unlimited traffic are available on paid plans. Lead enrichment starts on Grow.
What if I don't need optimization yet?
Start with the publishing features. Pro and Business build and publish landing pages, websites, and blogs with custom domains and SSL, from $29/mo. No A/B testing, no Smart Traffic, no heatmaps. Just publishing. When you're ready for optimization features, move up to Grow. Your pages and domains carry over.
How much does Leadpages cost?
Plans start at $29/mo to build and publish: Pro at $29/mo and Business at $49/mo. Optimization features start at $99/mo: Grow at $99/mo and Optimize at $199/mo, with Scale at $399/mo and Enterprise for larger teams. Every plan includes custom domains with SSL and AI page creation; Grow and up add A/B testing, personalization, and lead enrichment. 7-day free trial.
How does Leadpages compare to Unbounce?
Compare current plans using your required domains, client access, integrations and testing workflow. Leadpages has no traffic caps. Manual A/B testing starts on Grow. Smart Traffic and heatmaps start on Optimize. Pro and Business are publishing plans and do not include these testing features. AI page creation is available on paid plans. Lead enrichment and dynamic text replacement start on Grow. Check each provider’s current pricing and limits for the same configuration.
What's the difference between Grow and Optimize?

FAQ
Common questions about A/B testing
Do I need a developer to set up A/B tests?
No. Create a variant, pick a goal, set your traffic split, and publish. Everything happens inside the editor. No code, no JavaScript snippets, no tag manager configuration.
What happened to Google Optimize?
Google shut it down in September 2023. Leadpages includes A/B testing from the Grow plan ($99/mo), with no traffic cap on any plan.
How much traffic do I need to run a test?
The statistical engine will tell you when you have enough data to declare a winner with confidence. More traffic means faster results, but there's no minimum to start a test.
What's the difference between A/B testing and Smart Traffic?
A/B testing (Grow $99/mo) splits traffic evenly and measures which variant converts better. Smart Traffic (Optimize $199/mo) uses AI to route each visitor to the variant most likely to convert them. They work together: A/B testing finds winners, Smart Traffic routes intelligently.
Can I test more than two variants?
Yes. You can run several variants at once — A, B, C, D — and split traffic across all of them. The exact number depends on your plan.
What is Full Optimization?
Full Optimization (Scale $399/mo) runs a continuous testing loop: test, declare winner, generate next variant, test again. It's designed to run without manual intervention after initial setup.
